method_limits: the unit is the call row: the same callee appears once per caller, so a number here counts call sites and never functions; the site-level count is in parameter_write_sites and the two must not be compared

the temp label is a text test on the supplied argument (E432's marker list), so a caller that keeps a temp path in a variable whose name carries no marker is graded runtime_constant and lands outside the temp population; the pytest tmp_path rows are published as a separate blind-spot block for that reason
the name label is E428's heuristic verbatim (same word list, same function/path haystack), so the recall measured is the recall of the published instrument
caller_kind reads TEST_HINTS over the caller's file and function name: a helper module under a tests directory whose name carries no hint is graded product
reader detection matches a composed name as a whole path segment; a reader that builds the name from parts does not match
one call line reaches a two-parameter writer twice; only the first text per (caller file, caller function, line, callee) is kept

population_premise.measured: E434 applied a name test to the callee; a site-level temp label would inherit the same defect (one temp-passing caller marks a generic helper temp), so the unit here is the call row and the 30 is published as precision over the named call rows rather than as the temp population

title: cross-cut the directory-parameter call rows by whether the row supplies a temp directory and whether the callee's name carries a fixture word, and price the rows only one of the two labels sees
